npchelper 2.2.1 - tools for NPC Helper 2 content packs and DLL mods

USAGE
  npchelper new pack <folder> --id Author.PackName [--name "Pack Name"] [--author Me] [--npc Rei]
      Create a TOML content pack with a starter NPC and placeholder art.
  npchelper new npc <packFolder> <NpcName>
      Add a starter NPC to an existing pack.
  npchelper new dll-mod <folder> --id Author.ModName [--name "Mod Name"] [--author Me] [--npc Rei]
      Create a C# SMAPI mod project that defines NPCs in code (uses the NpcHelper.Sdk NuGet package).
  npchelper validate <packFolder> [--locale th] [--strict]
      Load the pack with the same code the game uses and print every problem. Exit code 1 on errors.
  npchelper inspect <packFolder> [--npc Rei] [--locale th]
      Show what the game will see: identity, images, variants, schedule keys, marriage data.
  npchelper pack <packFolder> [-o file.zip]
      Validate, then zip the pack for upload (skips bin/obj/.git/generated).
  npchelper release <release.json>
      Build multiple content-pack ZIPs, folder ZIPs, and NuGet packages from one release manifest.

Both outputs (content pack and DLL mod) run on the normal NPC Helper 2 SMAPI mod.
